name: Otome Game no Hametsu Flag Shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shite Shimatta...
original_name: 乙女ゲームの破滅フラグしかない悪役令嬢に転生してしまった…
source:
A game that's much more than just following the story of the TV anime!
What if Catarina had taken a different route?
Is Catarina able to avoid destruction and reach happiness?
Everything is up to you!
Enjoy creating the path of Catarina's fate!

[Edited from StoryMe]
translation:
一款远不止重现电视动画剧情的游戏！
如果卡塔莉娜选择了另一条道路，会怎样？
她能避开破灭，获得幸福吗？
一切由你决定！
享受亲手创造卡塔莉娜命运之路的乐趣吧！

[编译自StoryMe]
